instruction: In the empty space at the bottom left of the slide, draw an outline numeral 4 as a single freeform shape, in the same style as the big 1, 2 and 3 (a filled custom shape tracing the outline, no text).
notes: Region widened 2026-11-13: the numerals are 204.63 pt tall, so the old 195 pt region could not hold one in the same style; the empty area runs from below numeral 1 (y 302.5) to the slide bottom (540) and left of numeral 2 (x 346.8).
